MAP.formal: for p in {M1->M2, M2->M3, M3->M4}:  payload_p(s,d) <- payload_p(s, pi_class(d))
MAP.position_identity: PRESERVED — an M1->M2 outcome is only ever replaced by an M1->M2 outcome from another date

WHY_NOT_PER_POSITION_MAPS.defect: it would separate the Y values of DIFFERENT intraday horizons on the SAME real date, destroying cross-position same-date dependence
WHY_NOT_PER_POSITION_MAPS.direction_of_error: anti-conservative — a narrower family-wide max-stat null

DEPENDENCE_AXES_PRESERVED: one shared family-wide randomisation per draw

LESSON_SCOPE_OF_SHARED.observation: the scope of 'shared' was found too narrow THREE times
history: per-claim independent permutation — would destroy cross-claim dependence
per-security independent date maps — would destroy cross-security same-date dependence
per-position-pair maps — would destroy cross-position same-date dependence
LESSON_SCOPE_OF_SHARED.RULE: 'shared' must be stated by ENUMERATING every dependence axis it spans, never asserted as a single adjective

PAYLOAD.definition: (Y_availability, Y_value) MOVE TOGETHER as one payload
PAYLOAD.why: availability is part of the data-generating payload; separating it would break the date block
PAYLOAD.consequence_accepted: per-claim available N VARIES across draws

ACTIVE_WINDOW.derived_from: X-side coverage only (presence of COMPLETE opening-hour bars); known before any Y exposure

INTERNAL_GAPS.rule: an internal missing day is NOT an active-window boundary
INTERNAL_GAPS.handling: interior gaps remain represented through payload availability

PARTICIPATION_RULE.self_neutralising_note: X availability gates participation, so a payload permuted into an X-unavailable slot is never read; the listing artefact is therefore bounded

TRIMMING.measured_cost: trimming to the common active window (2024-06-10 .. 2026-05-01) would drop 767 of 1,242 DEV dates (61.76%)
TRIMMING.verdict: that would be a population REDESIGN merely to obtain a balanced panel
TRIMMING.measured_alternative: out-of-window slots are only 3,596 of 596,251 (0.6%); 346/476 securities span the full range

REJECTED_RULE.rule: exclude T_j^(b) from M_b only on the draws where claim j is undefined
REJECTED_RULE.defect: M_b would then be a maximum over a VARYING family size (e.g. 20,751 / 20,744 / 20,730)
REJECTED_RULE.direction_of_error: pulls the max-stat null systematically DOWNWARD on those draws — anti-conservative

FROZEN_RULE.name: PERMUTATION_STABILITY_GATE
FROZEN_RULE.requirement: a claim must be DEFINED on 200/200 SCALE draws AND 1800/1800 NULL draws

if_any_draw_undefined.max_stat_treatment: T_j^(b) = -inf on ALL draws, not merely the undefined ones
if_any_draw_undefined.registry: claim is NOT deleted; registered k remains 20,751 — it is inferentially untestable under this frozen mechanism

FROZEN_RULE.result: every M_b is computed over one and the same STABLE test set — fixed family dimension

REQUIRED_DIAGNOSTICS.status: DIAGNOSTICS ONLY — never a source of a new threshold
